Hi Olga / Ben —

We're kicking off our security review for Redwood as part of our vendor intake. Can you share your most recent SOC 2 Type II report for the period that covers 2024-10 through 2025-03 (or confirm coverage window)? Procurement also asked for an initial list of minimal evidence items and preferred secure transfer methods so our security team can triage.

- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and accompanying bridge letter if the period doesn't match our needs

- Secure upload options (SFTP/S3/Drive with instructions)

Can you also confirm an expected turnaround for the intake items (we're aiming to have materials ingested by 6/20)?

Thanks — happy to jump on a brief call if useful.
